params.body:
Second half of the fixture sweep that prepares the drop of `dealers.is_demo_user` (step 2b of removing the demo flag; first half in #904).

The remaining 71 files that still write `'is_demo_user' => 0` when they create a dealer: `tests/Feature` from `ProcessImageKeepsPhotoTest` on, and `tests/PageSeed.php`. Nothing reads the value and 0 is the column's default. After this pull request no fixture names the column, so the migration that drops it can follow.

## What changes

Only the `'is_demo_user' => 0` pair is removed from each fixture array. No assertion, no test name and no other value changes.

## Tests

Full suite locally on a private database with the schema of main: 2652 tests, green. PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: Fixtures no longer set the demo flag (2 of 2)
